info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Market Data Market Data Switch Administrations-spec
info.description: The Market Data Switch Administration API provides access to retrieve configurations and statuses of market data switch administrators. This API serves financial institutions and data providers who need to manage and monitor their market data feeds effectively. Users can query specific settings and utilize historical data to enhance their operational efficiency. Typical consumers include banking analysts and system administrators who optimize data flow management in trading environments.

get.summary: Retrieve market data switch administration details.
get.description: Fetches the current configuration and status of the market data switch administration, providing an overview of its settings and operational state for management and monitoring purposes.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving market data switch administration details. This operation allows the client to specify the parameters needed for fetching the relevant market data switch configurations and their current state.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the market data switch administration details.
